# Multi-source ML forecast versus Kalshi (generated by analysis/ml_compare.py; do not edit by hand)

ML random forest, walk-forward refits every 7 days on 2024-03-02 through D-2, 45 features.

### Accuracy on test days

Same contracts for every model. The blend is fit on train days only.

105 days, 630 contracts, 1000 day-level bootstrap replicates. Lower is better; brackets are 95% intervals.

| Model | Days | Contracts | Brier [95% CI] | Log loss [95% CI] |
| --- | ---: | ---: | --- | --- |
| ML random forest | 105 | 630 | 0.1129 [0.1052, 0.1206] | 0.3555 [0.3347, 0.3788] |
| Forecast consensus | 105 | 630 | 0.1154 [0.1083, 0.1226] | 0.3667 [0.3445, 0.3896] |
| Calibrated NOAA | 105 | 630 | 0.1229 [0.1143, 0.1318] | 0.3917 [0.3640, 0.4236] |
| GEFS ensemble | 105 | 630 | 0.1450 [0.1337, 0.1569] | 0.6558 [0.5371, 0.8024] |
| Climatology | 105 | 630 | 0.1685 [0.1533, 0.1823] | 0.5588 [0.5071, 0.6125] |
| Kalshi midpoint | 105 | 630 | 0.1091 [0.1010, 0.1172] | 0.3408 [0.3168, 0.3643] |
| Kalshi + ML blend | 105 | 630 | 0.1074 [0.0985, 0.1167] | 0.3319 [0.3054, 0.3584] |

| Difference (first − second) | Brier diff [95% CI] | Log loss diff [95% CI] | Share of replicates where first is better (Brier) |
| --- | --- | --- | ---: |
| ML random forest − Kalshi midpoint | 0.0037 [-0.0027, 0.0105] | 0.0147 [-0.0031, 0.0352] | 0.117 |
| ML random forest − Calibrated NOAA | -0.0100 [-0.0185, -0.0007] | -0.0362 [-0.0671, -0.0070] | 0.981 |
| ML random forest − Forecast consensus | -0.0025 [-0.0060, 0.0007] | -0.0112 [-0.0223, -0.0019] | 0.940 |
| Kalshi + ML blend − Kalshi midpoint | -0.0018 [-0.0039, 0.0004] | -0.0088 [-0.0145, -0.0033] | 0.943 |

Blend weights in log-odds: intercept 0.391, Kalshi 0.942, ML 0.388.

### Trading Kalshi with the ML forecast

Buy YES at the noon ask when ML exceeds it by the threshold, or NO at 1 − bid when ML is below the bid by the threshold. Kalshi taker fee 0.07 × P × (1 − P) per contract included; held to settlement. Threshold chosen on train days: **0.05**.
